name: room
text: Room opened — goal: visual: Mine AI website/product DESIGNS (the look), taste-learn from Eitan's picks.

name: Easel
text: I recommend we adopt a clean, minimalist design for the Mine AI website and product pages. This choice prioritizes user experience by making information easy to find and consume, which can enhance engagement and retention. The trade-off here is that we may sacrifice some visual flair or complexity, but the clarity and simplicity will ultimately showcase our AI capabilities better and resonate with a wider audience.

name: Squint
text: I'm not convinced that a minimalist design is the best approach, as it may come across as too sterile or unengaging, potentially deterring users who are looking for a more dynamic experience. A better alternative could be a balanced design that incorporates thoughtful typography, whitespace, and subtle visual elements to create a sense of depth and personality. To settle this argument, I'd like to see some user testing and feedback on different design prototypes to determine which approach resonates best with our target audience.
